about: Single machine-readable source of truth for project status. README and docs point here and do not restate status. Statuses: MET needs committed evidence tied to an experiment manifest; REPORTED_UNPROVEN was reported by a live session and has no manifest; NOT_MET has no qualifying evidence. Change this file only from evidence, in the same commit as the evidence or the reconciliation note that justifies it.

blockers.title: Client used for live experiments does not qualify as licensed-unmodified
blockers.detail: Master Spec invariant 13 and section 29. No experiment so far records client.supply = licensed-unmodified, so its results are discovery only and cannot be promoted to FACT or close any gate. Live protocol experimentation by autonomous agents is stopped on this path until a qualifying client is in place.

blockers.title: Live runtime is not attributable to a commit
blockers.detail: Restart the server and relay from a clean checkout of a recorded commit before any run that is meant to be evidence.

blockers.title: Master Spec section 5 and the execution contract describe a superseded frontier
blockers.detail: The spec is locked, so it was not edited. Proposed wording is in the reconciliation note.

blockers.title: Runtime lineage is not clean-room and is under a noncommercial licence
blockers.detail: The replacement runtime is an adaptation of a third-party server for a later title, licensed PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. The Master Spec describes clean-room research and a product platform. Needs a deliberate decision before any product code depends on it. See docs/license-decision.md.
